description: CM4(Manchester Road Mayo Avenue) is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council. Location specific rainfall data (based on a 1Km spatial resolution) for Air Quality Management Stations in the Bradford District. Estimates of rainfall totals (mm) and intensity (mm/hr) are derived from Met Office rainfall radar observations based on ground truthing comparisons with known historic rainfall values. Time intervals correspond to published 2018 AQMA dataset. Coverage: City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council. The portal files it under the publisher City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council. Its tags are Climate, Environment, Rainfall. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
